subject: Fix LeaveSpy/LeaveTree launched with priority NotYetSet
description: Latent hazard flagged during #26: engine/commands.rs launches LeaveSpy/LeaveTree elements with priority NotYetSet, which would trip element_priority.rs's debug catch-all panic if such an element reaches DeterminePriority. Check what priority C++ assigns at the equivalent launch sites and port it. Low urgency; no known trace hits it yet.
